sources.snippet: The new preferred method of text node output is STRING. This is a change from ASCII so that it is more clear what data is being passed. The was_suite_config.json will automatically set use_legacy_ascii_text to false. Video Nodes - There are two new video nodes, Write to Video and Create Video from Path. These are experimental nodes.
